_comment: Per-field value guide (generated by scripts/build_value_guide.py from schema.json). Tells a filler what each field should contain, with formats, address components, calculations to validate, and adversarial values to avoid. Not legal advice.

county.label: County
county.expects: a Maine county name WITHOUT the word 'County' (the form prints 'COUNTY'); rendered upper-case

docket_no.label: Docket No
avoid: a docket from another jurisdiction's format

estate_of.label: Estate Of
estate_of.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

omitted_child_info.label: Omitted Child Info
omitted_child_info.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

circumstances_existed.label: Circumstances Existed
circumstances_existed.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

omission_intent.label: Omission Intent
omission_intent.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

basis_facts.label: Basis Facts
basis_facts.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

intestate_share_prayer.label: Intestate Share Prayer
intestate_share_prayer.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

date.label: Date
date.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

attorney_name.label: Attorney Name
attorney_name.expects: full legal name as it should appear on the order
avoid: 'Last, First' order unless the line calls for it

attorney_address.label: Attorney Address
attorney_address.expects: an address with: street, city, state, zip
avoid: the state spelled out ('Maine') when an abbreviation fits
a PO box where a physical/legal residence is required

attorney_bar_number.label: Maine Bar Number
attorney_bar_number.expects: free text answering the printed prompt
